purpose: Public Applied Practical Thinking portfolio, learning, demonstration, and publication platform.
description: A pnpm monorepo containing a Vite and React public website, a separately deployed Cloudflare Worker API and AI subsystem, shared UI/config/knowledge packages, authored public content, and generators that publish an explicitly selected subset of canonical APT doctrine from the sibling apt-principles-agents repository.

architecture.summary: A browser application and Worker backend share workspace packages and publication contracts; authored product content and selected sibling doctrine are transformed into generated runtime assets for the public site.
components: apps/web provides the Vite, React, and TypeScript public experience, routes, authored content, design doctrine, publication generators, and validation scripts.
apps/worker provides the Hono-based Cloudflare Worker API, public feed assembly, AI and vector-search boundaries, and normalized content delivery.
packages/ui, packages/config, and packages/knowledge provide shared presentation, token/config, and content/domain contracts.
apps/web/scripts generates indexes, validation evidence, copied runtime content, and the curated public APT doctrine projection.
apt-principles-agents remains canonical for reusable APT doctrine and agent assets; this repository owns its product implementation, public narrative, local exceptions, and deployment configuration.
architecture.runtime_model: The web app runs in the browser from a Vite development or production bundle. The Cloudflare Worker runs independently at the API boundary and accesses Pages-hosted public assets plus a remote Vectorize index.
architecture.deployment_model: Cloudflare Pages builds and serves apps/web from GitHub updates. apps/worker is deployed separately with Wrangler and GitHub Actions; the web and Worker communicate through an explicit VITE_API_BASE and PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN contract.

runtime.summary: Install the pnpm workspace, run the Vite web application and Wrangler Worker independently, generate publication assets before web builds, and deploy the two Cloudflare surfaces separately.

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.declared: No engines field is declared in the root package.json

requirements.name: pnpm
requirements.declared: pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml define the workspace
requirements.recommended: Use Corepack-managed pnpm consistently with the committed lockfile

requirements.name: Cloudflare configuration
requirements.declared: Worker compatibility date 2026-01-25 with a remote Vectorize binding
requirements.recommended: Set VITE_API_BASE for Pages and PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN for the Worker before production deployment

runtime.package_manager: pnpm workspace commands at the repository root delegate to apps/web and apps/worker.
runtime.local_server: pnpm dev starts the generated-and-validated Vite web experience; pnpm dev:worker starts the Cloudflare Worker separately.
runtime.build: pnpm build runs configuration checks, APT public-doctrine generation, validation reporting, content-index generation, public-copy generation, and the Vite production build.
runtime.deployment: Cloudflare Pages deploys the web output from GitHub builds; pnpm deploy:worker publishes the Worker through Wrangler.

structure.purpose: Public React application, authored public content, design doctrine, publication scripts, and web validation.
Generated runtime copies of public content, documentation, data, and curated APT doctrine.
Cloudflare Worker API, AI/vector boundaries, feed assembly, runtime configuration, and deployment surface.
Shared semantic token and configuration contracts.
Shared public-content, feed, domain, and assistant contracts.
Internal engineering, architecture, deployment, decision, maintenance, and agent-facing documentation.
Target-owned supporting material used by the public platform and its maintainers.
Managed APT assets and tool-native adapters synchronized from apt-principles-agents plus target-owned workflow configuration.
Generated internal and public-safe validation evidence.
Timestamped recovery copies created before forced managed-asset replacement.

integrations: Cloudflare Pages builds and serves the public Vite application.
Cloudflare Workers and Hono provide the API, AI, feed, and document-normalization boundary.
Cloudflare Vectorize supplies the remote knowledge index bound as VECTORIZE.
GitHub Actions deploys the Worker through .github/workflows/worker.yml.
apt-principles-agents supplies managed standards and an explicitly curated public doctrine projection.
Codex, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini consume synchronized tool-native APT adapters.

canonical: apps/web/content/, apps/web/data/, and apps/web/docs/design/ own authored public product content, registries, and design doctrine.
apps/worker/ owns API behavior, Worker configuration, AI/vector boundaries, and feed assembly.
packages/ owns shared UI, configuration, token, knowledge, and content contracts.
docs/ owns target-local operating context, decisions, deployment guidance, and exceptions.
apt-principles-agents—not this repository—owns reusable APT doctrine, standards, skills, agents, and distribution tooling.
generated: apps/web/public/content/, apps/web/public/docs/, and apps/web/public/data/ are generated runtime projections.
apps/web/data/generated/aptPrinciplesPublicManifest.ts is generated from the canonical public APT selection.
apps/web/docs/design/tokens.json is a compatibility projection generated from apps/web/docs/design/static/APT-TOKENS-CONTRACT.json.
archived: .apt-backups/ contains recovery evidence only and must not be treated as active source.
Historical material under a docs/archive/ boundary, when present, is provenance rather than current direction.

constraints: Do not edit apps/web/public copied content or generated indexes as authored source.
Do not redefine reusable APT doctrine locally; change apt-principles-agents and regenerate the approved public projection.
Use semantic design tokens rather than raw color values in application components.
Keep VITE_API_BASE and PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN explicit and aligned across Pages and Worker deployments.
Preserve Worker-backed public feed contracts for Labs, Proof, and Insights.
Treat payment, security, privacy, public claims, and AI behavior as high-accuracy review domains.
Deploy the Worker before rebuilding Pages when runtime contracts or environment configuration change.

evidence.supports: Purpose, repository shape, documentation boundaries, commands, Cloudflare model, public-feed architecture, and APT publication flow.
Target-local design, component, generated-output, testing, and deployment rules.
Root pnpm command interface for web, Worker, validation, tests, and deployment.
Web build pipeline, content generation, validation, lint, and publication tests.
Worker runtime and Wrangler deployment commands.
Worker identity, compatibility date, public site origin, observability, and remote Vectorize binding.
Managed APT manifests, adapters, per-file provenance, and current canonical source commit.
Reviewed managed-drift classification, registry resolution, and repair gate.

architecture_pattern: Vite/React public site plus Cloudflare Worker BFF with shared workspace contracts and generated publication projections
command_matrix: See commands[] in this version-2 profile.
validation_evidence: APT conformance, ESLint and documentation governance, publication contract tests, Vitest, and production web build
release_model: Cloudflare Pages deployment from GitHub plus a separately deployed Wrangler Worker
operations_model: Author in canonical local sources, generate governed runtime projections, validate, build, deploy Worker, then deploy Pages

showcase.summary: Public APT portfolio and learning platform demonstrating governed doctrine publication, practical design and architecture, and Worker-backed content delivery.
